confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for the July 2026 window from general knowledge; no menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence. Cocktail and wine use a local beer-price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. Hostel and hotel rates are least certain (district and holiday-season demand), and peso movements can shift USD values. The FX figure came from web search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis from general knowledge of Colombian and Latin American capital-city price levels, with Medellin, Lima and Quito as loose reference points. No live comparison was performed.
